connect.body: Fonts are drawn by talking to the agent of your code editor. Link it to NetsuFont with this command.
connect.ask: Then ask it, for instance: "draw a rounded font, capitals first".

crash.title: Something broke the display
crash.body: Your fonts are untouched: they are in their files. Reload the page; if it comes back, this is the error to report.

empty.title: No font yet
empty.offlineBody: Start it from the project folder with this command.

HAMBURGEFONTSIV 0123456789
